device_entry.name: SHFSG 超高频信号发生器
tags: 量子比特脉冲控制与读出
device_entry.description: 用于产生可编程高频信号的仪器，支持 AWG 测序器、波形存储、命令表、触发/标记配置、脉冲调制和正弦信号生成功能，常用于量子控制、微波脉冲实验和射频测试。
device_entry.description_en: An instrument for generating programmable high-frequency signals. It supports an AWG sequencer, waveform memory, command tables, trigger/marker configuration, pulse modulation, and sine generation, and is commonly used for quantum control, microwave pulse experiments, and RF testing.
